hook.text: A noisy photo can be smoothed. A crackly recording can be cleaned. Filters separate signal from noise.

buildup.text: A filter passes certain frequencies and blocks others. Low-pass filters remove high-frequency noise.

discovery.text: The Wiener filter is optimal: it minimizes the expected difference between the filtered and original signal.

twist.text: Filtering always loses some signal. Aggressive noise removal smears details. The tradeoff is fundamental.

climax.text: AI denoising learns the difference between noise and signal from millions of examples. It outperforms classical filters.

punchline.text: Remove the noise, keep the signal. Easier said than done.

quiz.question: What tradeoff does filtering involve?
options: Removing noise vs preserving signal detail
